# Load workbook and snapshot all cell values before modification
wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_position)
answer_cells = {
    (row, col)
    for row in range(min_row, max_row + 1)
    for col in range(min_col, max_col + 1)
}

# Snapshot existing values in all worksheets to verify only answer_position changed on Sheet1
before_values = {}
for s in wb.worksheets:
    for row in range(1, s.max_row + 1):
        for col in range(1, s.max_column + 1):
            before_values[(s.title, row, col)] = s.cell(row=row, column=col).value

# Modify ONLY G3:G5 with an ordinary scalar formula.
# Logic: if F >= 0, subtract M when M has a value; otherwise subtract J when J has a value;
# otherwise subtract 0 so G displays F when both J and M are blank/"".
for row in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=min_col)
    cell.value = f'=IF(F{row}>=0,F{row}-IF(M{row}<>"",M{row},IF(J{row}<>"",J{row},0)),"")'

# Save to required output path
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification
wb_out = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)

    assert isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("="), f"{ws_out.cell(row=row, column=min_col).coordinate} is not a formula"
    upper_v = v.upper()
    assert not any(tok in upper_v for tok in bad_tokens), f"Unsafe formula token found in {ws_out.cell(row=row, column=min_col).coordinate}: {v}"

# Confirm no cell outside answer_position was changed, comparing cell values in used ranges
changed_outside = []
for s in wb_out.worksheets:
    max_r = max(s.max_row, wb[s.title].max_row if s.title in wb.sheetnames else 0)
    max_c = max(s.max_column, wb[s.title].max_column if s.title in wb.sheetnames else 0)
    for row in range(1, max_r + 1):
        for col in range(1, max_c + 1):
            if s.title == "Sheet1" and (row, col) in answer_cells:
                continue
            old = before_values.get((s.title, row, col))
            new = s.cell(row=row, column=col).value
            if old != new:
                changed_outside.append((s.title, row, col, old, new))

print("Changed cells outside answer_position:", changed_outside)
assert not changed_outside, "Cells outside answer_position were changed."
